Results.ReviewText: This is our 3rd Weber grill, same size.  We were very upset when it was delivered pit together, to see the back panel did not cover the back of the cabinet.  The store where we purchased the weber grill had the same model and the back panel height covered about 3/4 of the back panel.  The parts booklet that came with the grill, showed the higher back panel.  The panel that was put on the grill covered only about 1/4 of the back.  We live in an area where there are many animals and they would be able to easily get into the back of the grill cabinet.  In reading online, we learned that Weber was cost cutting and reduced the height of the rear panel to save money????  Luckily, the store where we bought the weber grill, removed the back panel from the store model and we now have the back panel (higher) that we expected.  Sorry to say, we will not purchase another weber grill in the future.
Results.Title: Disappointed with weber

Results.ReviewText:
I bought the E-210 two burner because the two of us rarely grill for more than two and we were replacing a three burner that was really two big. Small can some times not be good because I had a hard time installing a full gas tank as I couldn't maneuver in the small space to reach the tank hanger/gauge. The side wall of the grill is not strong enough to support the full tank so it deflects inside with the weight. This idea of measuring the level of the tank by weight is inaccurate and a waste of time as any one who has a gas grill knows that when fuel runs out it is time to change. And lastly, why is the back of the grill not fully inclosed? How much money can Weber save by eliminating a 24" * 18" piece of sheet metal? I can assure you the local cats and raccoons will soon discover the route to the grease collector and deposit it on the garage floor. 

With that being said, the good points. The grill is overall well made and sturdy. It lights immediately and heats up quickly. The grates are heavy and easy to clean. The grease collection system is well designed and easy to clean. (If you can keep the animals out. I'm having a metal screen made to enclose my grill fully.) Overall I am pleased and satisfied with my purchase.

Results.ReviewText:
Had two concerns when I purchased this grill. 
I thought it might prove too small. 90% of the time it is just my wife and I, so it made sense. However, it can comfortably cook for 6 or 8 and with little creative time management it will work for even more. 
I had heard concerns about longer times to heat up, due to just 2 burners. I have found it heats up just as quickly as my old Spirit 310. A bonus is that it doesn’t suddenly spike to 5 or 600 degrees. Easier to manage cooking temperature and cooks very evenly across the grill. 
My chicken doesn’t develop a tough, thoroughly cooked outer layer and the burgers are cooked evenly inside and out. I am very pleased with the performance. 
Another plus: With the tables dropped and cover on it doesn’t block much of the view from my deck. Easy to forget it is even there.
Results.Title: Much Better Than Anticipated.

Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.
